title: The Millers
premise_summary: The Millers is an American sitcom television series that was created by Greg Garcia and stars Will Arnett as Nathan Miller and Margo Martindale as Carol Miller. The multi-camera series aired from October 3, 2013, to July 18, 2015, and ran 34 episodes over two seasons on CBS.
